messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

    earlier: The event bus is owned by Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-03; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- On 2025-06-27, Team Boreal observed that the event bus's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-06-27]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]

- As of 2025-12-23, the pager for the auth gateway rings Team Atlas instead of Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
- As of 2026-02-19, the Boreal team consists of Lena only, after Marcus moved to Team Atlas. [valid 2026-02-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-02-19]
    earlier: As of January 2025, the Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus. [valid 2025-01-07 to 2026-02-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- As of 2025-11-20, dashboards and alerts for the event bus are being repointed. [valid 2025-11-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-20-event-bus]
- On 2026-05-04, Team Boreal decided that the event bus will retain messages for seven days because replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. [decision; valid 2026-05-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-05-04]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Cinder observed that the event bus's CPU sat at 90 percent following the traffic shift, and flagged it since the event bus is not Team Cinder's service. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-03]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]

- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]

Question: Why was the event-bus moved from Boreal to Atlas?
